seo_title: AI Anti-Ban Agent: Protect Your Meta and Google Accounts
seo_desc: Blocked Meta or Google accounts? We integrate an AI Agent that audits your ads and landings in real-time to ensure policy compliance and prevent bans.
author_pitch: As a Senior AI Engineer, I have seen entire businesses collapse due to automated Ads bans. My mission is to build algorithmic firewalls to shield your revenue and keep your campaigns running uninterrupted.
title: AI Anti-Ban Agent: Shielding Your Ad Accounts from Costly Suspensions
body:
Are you dealing with suspended Meta Ads or Google Ads accounts during peak sales seasons without knowing why?

For clinics, law firms, e-commerce brands, and businesses in regulated sectors, an algorithmic ban is a financial tragedy. You lose thousands of dollars in daily revenue, your team is paralyzed, and you face a labyrinth of automated appeals with bots that reject your requests without clear explanations. A simple copywriting mistake or a forbidden word hidden on your landing page can destroy your ROAS and freeze your income for weeks.

The trap of manual creative review

Traffickers and copywriters cannot memorize the endless and ever-changing policies of Google and Facebook. Uploading massive campaigns crossing your fingers exposes you to irreversible suspensions. Launching ads without a pre-algorithmic audit is playing Russian roulette with your business.

Our solution: AI Ad Compliance Agent

At LANZA ESTUDIO, we develop and integrate an AI Agent that acts as a firewall between your marketing team and the advertising platform. Using specialized LLMs and real-time Web Scraping, it audits every text, image, and landing page prior to publication, detecting violations with surgical precision and suggesting safe variations.

  1. Predictive Copy Auditing: Analyzes headlines and descriptions, detecting forbidden clauses, unrealistic promises, or bannable language in seconds.
  2. Deep Landing Page Scanning: Crawls the destination URL simulating Google/Meta bots to detect broken links, aggressive pop-ups, or prohibited medical/financial claims.
  3. Multimodal Image Analysis: Uses computer vision AI to check that your creatives do not violate excessive text rules, suggestive imagery, or prohibited personal attributes.
  4. Automated Safety Rewriting: If a ban risk is detected, the agent immediately generates copy alternatives that maintain persuasion but strictly comply with current policies.

The Real Impact on Your Campaign Stability

  • Zero accidental suspensions: Eliminate the stress and MRR loss caused by unexpected Business Manager or Google Ads bans.
  • Instant ad approval: Reduce technical rejections, allowing you to launch hundreds of variations and A/B tests without friction.
  • Pixel and Data Protection: Keep your campaign learning history intact by preventing blocks that reset your audiences.
